other.remelting: at least three times under high vacuum

evidence.quote: Alloy ingots with nominal composition of AlCoCrCuFeNi were prepared by arc melting mixture of commercial-pure metals (purity better than 99 wt.%) in a Ti-gettered high-purity argon atmosphere. The ingots were then remelted at least three times to improve homogeneity under high vacuum.
After that, the ingots were suction cast into a water-cooled copper mould to obtain cylindrical rods of 43 × 70 mm.

mechanisms.name: slip resistance from dense {110} BCC planes

evidence.quote: a slip along the closest packing planes {1 10} in BCC structure is more difficult than along those {1 1 1} in FCC structure as {1 10} planes are dense and more irregular and thus possess a smaller interplanar spacing and higher lattice friction for dislocation motion than {1 1 1} planes in the atomic scale.

mechanisms.name: solid-solution strengthening by Al and Cr in BCC

evidence.quote: the incorporation of stronger binding elements like Al and high melting point elements like Cr in BCC phase increases the Young's modulus and slip resistance

mechanisms.name: FCC transformation enabling additional slip systems

evidence.quote: However, the alloys aged at elevated temperature for 5 h exhibit higher plastic strain, which is due to BCC transform into FCC structure, as known that the slip directions of FCC structure are more than those of BCC structure.

mechanisms.name: Cu segregation driven by Gibbs free energy

evidence.quote: The segregation of Cu is caused by different Gibbs free energy between every two elements.
